sections.title: Oral Health Equity and Dental Medicaid: Exploring Avenues for Advocacy
sections.description: PUBH 599 is reserved for MPH students to complete an independent study with a predetermined faculty member. The topics will be determined in coordination with that faculty. Consultation with MPH program and faculty is required before registration. The option to complete an independent study requires approval from academic advisor and Director of the MPH program.
